Ein Dachfenster, das live aufgeht, ein T: A roof window that opens live, a terrace roof and a carport on posts.
In diesem Teil zeige ich dir Dachfenster: In this part I show you roof windows with a blind, contacts and a motor, a flat roof as a free shape, the canopy and “Roof stays”.
Wir machen mit dem Dachgeschoss aus Teil: We carry on with the attic from part one: the knee wall, the dormer and the cross gable are done. Now light comes in from the other side.
Unter der Liste der Dachflächen steht de: Below the list of roof sections there's the “Roof windows” section – „Dachfenster“. “+ Roof window” – „+ Dachfenster“ – puts a window into a roof section.
Es landet auf der Südseite des Hauptdach: It lands on the south side of the main roof, 78 by 118 centimetres, a common size. In the plan it's the small rectangle.
Im Plan ziehst du es an die richtige Ste: In the plan you drag it to the right spot. I move it a little to the right, over the hallway.
Ziehst du es weiter, wechselt es auf ein: Drag it further and it changes to another roof section – here onto the side wing above the master bedroom.
Oben im Formular steht, auf welcher Dach: At the top of the form you can see which roof section it's on – „Dachfläche“. You can also pick it there. I go back to the main roof, south side.
„Breite“ und „Höhe“ ändern die Größe. Ic: “Width” and “Height” – „Breite“ and „Höhe“ – change the size. I take 94 by 140 centimetres.
„Abstand vom Rand“ und „Abstand von der: “Distance from the edge” and “Distance from the eaves” – „Abstand vom Rand“ and „Abstand von der Traufe“ – fix the position to the centimetre.
Wie ein normales Fenster hat das Dachfen: Just like a normal window, the roof window has a “Blind” – „Rollladen“ – a “Contact” – „Kontakt“ – and a “Tilt contact” – „Kippkontakt“.
Meldet der Kontakt offen, klappt der Flü: When the contact reports open, the sash swings outwards in 3D, hinged at the top, and the frame glows warm.
Tilted, it only opens a little.
Und fährt der Rollladen herunter, schieb: And when the blind comes down, it slides over the glass from the top.
Hat dein Dachfenster einen Motor, wählst: If your roof window has a motor, you pick it under “Window motor” – „Fenstermotor“. It reports its position as a cover, and the sash in 3D opens exactly that far.
Kontakt und Kippkontakt gehen aber auch: Contact and tilt contact work without a motor too. The “Name” – „Name“ – is optional, handy when you have several roof windows.
Weil das Fenster ein Loch in die Schräge: Because the window cuts a hole into the slope, in 3D you can look out of the attic.
„Fixieren“, „Löschen“ und oben „Dachfläc: “Fix”, “Delete” and “Roof sections” at the top, back to the list – „Fixieren“, „Löschen“ and „Dachflächen“ – work like for any roof section.
Ein Flachdach muss kein Rechteck sein. E: A flat roof doesn't have to be a rectangle. An example: our ground floor on its own, as a bungalow with a flat roof.
Ich habe eine Dachfläche darübergezogen: I've drawn a roof section over it and chosen „Flach“. But the rectangle also covers the corners where there's no house at all.
Bei „Flach“ und „Attika“ gibt es dafür „: For „Flach“ and „Attika“ there's “Take the floor's outline” – „Umriss des Geschosses übernehmen“.
Die Fläche bekommt den Umriss aller Räum: The section takes the outline of all rooms of the floor shown – L- or Z-shaped too – as one surface without seams.
Die Ecken ziehst du danach im Plan, so s: Afterwards you drag the corners in the plan, as the hint says. Here I pull the roof out over the garage entrance.
„Zurück zum Rechteck“ löscht die freie F: “Back to the rectangle” – „Zurück zum Rechteck“ – removes the free shape again.
Hat dein Haus mehrere Etagen, wählst du: If your house has several floors, you choose with the floor buttons at the top which floor provides the outline.
Zurück zu unserem Haus. Vor das Wohnzimm: Back to our house. A terrace roof goes in front of the living room. You simply draw a roof section where there's no room.
NeonPlan macht daraus von selbst eine Üb: NeonPlan turns it into a canopy by itself: a flat pent roof at 2.4 metres, carried by posts and beams, with a see-through roof.
An der Hauswand liegt es auf. Im Formula: At the house wall it rests on the wall. In the form, “Canopy” – „Überdachung“ – is ticked for this, and the list and the plan say „Überdachung“.
Genauso entsteht der Carport neben der G: The carport next to the garage works the same way: draw the section, done.
Den Schalter „Überdachung“ hat jede Dach: Every roof section has the „Überdachung“ switch. Without the tick it becomes a normal roof without posts – with the tick, a carport again.
Zum Schluss die 3D-Ansicht. Zoomst du na: Finally the 3D view. When you zoom in close, the roof lifts off so you can look into the house.
Willst du das Dach auch aus der Nähe seh: If you want to see the roof up close, say the dormer or the roof window, switch on “Roof stays” – „Dach bleibt“ – at the bottom.
Jetzt bleibt es auf dem Haus, auch ganz: Now it stays on the house, even very close up. The switch is there in the house view as soon as your house has a roof.
Ein zweiter Klick schaltet ihn wieder au: A second click switches it off again.
Gaube, Zwerchgiebel, Dachfenster, Terras: Dormer, cross gable, roof window, terrace roof and carport – all made of roof sections.
Das war Teil zwei: Dachfenster mit Rolll: That was part two: roof windows with a blind, contacts and a motor, the flat roof as a free shape, the terrace roof, the carport and the “Roof stays” switch.
